messagingSessionId.title: Messaging Session ID
messagingSessionId.description: The Id of this conversation (MessagingSession). Bound from the context variable RoutableId; never ask the patient for it.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: What the patient needs, in their own words.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Optional: the serial number of the patient's device the request is about, for example Test8.
